title: The Artful Blossom for Procreate
author: SofydollDesigns
description:
The Artful Blossom for Procreate is a uniquely fun set for creating colorful, flowery art.
It includes 36 softly textured brushes as well as 3 blender brushes, a rich canvas texture PLUS a Procreate file scrapbook paper (in 2 versions) and 20 flower elements (with and without shadows) so, along with your art, you can create lovely digital craft paper poems, posies, etc.
See images for more details.
Included in this set:
• 36 Brushes
• 3 Blender Brushes
• 1 Canvas Texture
• 1 Scrapbook Paper in 2 versions (Procreate file)
• 20 Flower Elements (PNG with/without shadows)
